item: GO #8 (owner: 'test what you need before turning the knobs'; director astro-imaging-45; worker this session) — a MEASUREMENT: the direction of the corner elongation on the raws, the members and the corpus; pre-registered at datasets/aug06/experiments.jsonl line 104, RESULT line 105; this record carries every number.

preregistration_verbatim.status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE ANY CORNER BOX IS MEASURED. Owner-directed ('test what you need before turning the knobs'); director astro-imaging-45; worker this session. A MEASUREMENT: no knob, no build, no product touched.
preregistration_verbatim.question: The owner sees long trailing at ALL FOUR corners of the corpus, and the director's corner boxes read FWHM 2.67-3.03 vs centre 2.52 with the elongation DIRECTION differing per corner (drift-aligned at BL, near-tangential at BR, radial-or-drift at TL, round at TR). Along the mid-row the radial and drift directions coincide, so GO #5-#7 could not separate them; the corners can: is the corner elongation RADIAL (coma-like optics), TANGENTIAL (astigmatism-like), aligned to the sensor x-AXIS (a sensor-axis mechanism: drift/readout/demosaic), or MIXED — and is it night-dependent like the mid-row?
preregistration_verbatim.angle_convention: Siril findstar's angle is read in the image's y-DOWN (top-origin) frame, x-axis = 0, axis angle mod 180 — CHECKED on GO #6's corpus band where local +RA is tilted 8-14 deg from horizontal: the y-down deviations are 0.9-7.6 deg, the y-up 19-36 deg, so y-down is the tool's frame (the director's convention). Radial = the axis from the frame centre to the box centre in that frame, tangential = radial + 90, all compared mod 180 via the top-30 e-weighted axial mean of the major axis (the GO #5 method).
preregistration_verbatim.step1_raws: the 18 converted raws of GO #7 (sessions/<night>/work/rawshape/<set>/out/c_0000N.fit, debayered, uncalibrated, unwarped, 6064x4040): four 800-px boxes centred at y-down pixels TL (600,600), TR (5464,600), BL (600,3440), BR (5464,3440) — rho = 0.78 of the half-diagonal (2816 px of 3643) — via a hand .ssf of shape_at_sky's own form (load / crop / findstar per box, gate 'setfindstar reset -roundness=0.10 -relax=on -maxR=1.0') through the serialized invoker, lists kept. Per box: n, top-30 FWHM (x+y)/2, roundness, e, the axial-mean major-axis angle and its deviation from (a) radial, (b) tangential, (c) the sensor x-axis; per set the median over its 3 raws.
preregistration_verbatim.step2_members: the corresponding canonical members: sub_01 of each set (its reference frame is the set's first raw by construction) plus the member holding the middle raw (aug14/set-04 sub_04, aug14/set-05 sub_02, aug09/set-05 sub_02, aug06/set-02 sub_02, july31/set-01 sub_03, july31/set-03 sub_03; from the members' STACKCNT and the culled capture order). Boxes in the MEMBER's own pixel frame at (600,600), (W-600,600), (600,H-600), (W-600,H-600) — the assumed mapping: the member canvas is the reference frame's undistorted geometry minus a framing=min crop (5767-5832 x 3927-3952 vs the raw's 6064x4040), so a member corner box sits ~(6064-W)/2 = 116-149 px further from the raw's x-edges and ~44-57 px from its y-edges than the raw box does (rho 0.78 -> ~0.74) and the undistort's scale is inside that; stated, not corrected. Same statistics; then member minus raw per corner in size and direction.
preregistration_verbatim.step3_corpus_BL: the corpus's BL boxes at y-down corpus pixels (700,4200) and (1300,4900): RA/Dec re-derived from the corpus WCS at FITS (x, 5677 - y_down); shape_at_sky on the corpus (lists kept; the tool's own placement check must return these pixels); GO #6's coverage method over the 77 members (full 800-px box), shape_at_sky on every covering member at that sky, the member corner/edge each contributes from (distance to its edges, exit/entry role), corpus vs the covering members' median/best.

rules_pre_registered.OPTICS_RADIAL: a set's four raw corners each within 20 deg of their radial direction (coma-like)
rules_pre_registered.AXIS: each within 20 deg of the sensor x-axis at all four corners (a sensor-axis mechanism, not a lens symmetry)
rules_pre_registered.night_dependence: whether the corner readings order by night as the mid-row did (aug14 > aug09 > july31/set-03 > aug06 > july31/set-01 at +2400)
rules_pre_registered.stacking_adds: member minus raw per corner: size, and the direction change — a rotation of the elongation toward the drift axis = a drift-coupled addition; toward radial/tangential = the optics dominating
rules_pre_registered.corpus_BL_attribution: GO #6's rules with the allowance CORRECTED to the measured compose floor: MEMBER-BORNE if the corpus is within +0.265 px FWHM (0.165 + 0.10) and 0.03 roundness of the covering members' MEDIAN; COMPOSE-ADDED if worse than the BEST by > 0.20 / 0.05 AND worse than the median by > 0.265 / 0.03; else NEITHER, reported

preregistration_verbatim.no_destructive_steps: raws, members and the corpus read only; .ssf, logs and lists under sessions/<night>/work/{rawshape,corner_attr}/ (gitignored); tracked outputs: this ledger's two entries and the corpus record

instrument: hand .ssf of shape_at_sky's own form (load / crop / findstar per box, gate 'setfindstar reset -roundness=0.10 -relax=on -maxR=1.0') through scripts/lib/siril_run.py; per box the top-30-by-amplitude median of (FWHMx+FWHMy)/2, min/max roundness, e, and the e-weighted axial-mean major-axis angle (Siril's axis angle, y-down frame) vs radial / tangential / x-axis; raws = GO #7's 18 converted frames; members = sub_01 + the middle-raw member of each set; the corpus's BL via shape_at_sky.py at RA/Dec re-derived from the corpus WCS at FITS (x, 5677 - y_down)

reading: STEP 1, RAW CORNERS (18 raws, y-down frame, rho 0.77; radial directions TL 30.3 / BL 149.7 / BR 30.3 / TR 149.7 deg): every set is MIXED by the rule, with ONE pattern on all six: the two BOTTOM corners are RADIAL — BR within 0.3-19 deg of radial on every set and the strongest elongation on the frame (e 0.30-0.49 on aug14/aug09/aug06/july31-set-03, 0.13 on july31/set-01), BL within 0.9-14 deg (e 0.16-0.26) — while the two TOP corners are NOT radial: TR sits 7-13 deg from the sensor x-axis on aug06/aug14/aug09/july31-set-03 (17-20 deg from radial on aug14/aug09, an ambiguity of the 30-deg gap between the radial and x directions there) and 33 deg from everything on july31/set-01; TL is 50-66 deg from radial, 24-40 from tangential and 20-36 from x on every set, with the weakest ellipticity (e 0.14-0.17). So the optical (coma-like, radial) term is present on the bottom half of the sensor and weak-to-absent on the top half — a top/bottom asymmetry under one lens — and the field-constant drift trail (x-axis) shows through where the optical term is weak. Not OPTICS-RADIAL, not OPTICS-TANGENTIAL, not AXIS. NIGHT DEPENDENCE at the corners: the two RIGHT (entry-side) corners order like the mid-row — TR aug14 2.91 > aug09 2.60 > july31/set-03 2.40 > aug06 2.32 > july31/set-01 2.30; BR aug14 2.75-2.78 > aug09 2.57 > july31/set-03 2.32 > july31/set-01 2.26 > aug06 2.22 — and TL follows it (aug14 2.47-2.49 > aug09 2.41 > the rest 2.24-2.29); BL, the exit-side bottom corner, does NOT (spread 0.28 px, aug14/set-04 fourth of six). The soft night is soft on its right half and its top-left, not at BL. STEP 2, MEMBER CORNERS (sub_01 + the member holding the middle raw, boxes 600 px from the MEMBER's edges — 116-199 px further from the raw's x-edges, 44-71 px in y, by the framing=min crop; stated, not corrected): stacking adds +0.13..+0.37 px FWHM at every corner (the GO #7 floor) and ROUNDS every corner (+0.03..+0.23 roundness): the exit-side BL corners become nearly round on every member (e 0.01-0.04, roundness 0.96-0.99, from raw e 0.16-0.26) and TL nearly so (e 0.03-0.12); the entry-side corners keep their elongation — BR stays RADIAL on every member (1-8 deg, e 0.10-0.33) with rotation 0-10 deg from the raw, TR keeps the raw's direction to 0-10 deg (x-axis-near on aug06/aug09/aug14/july31-03, e 0.13-0.20). Direction change under stacking: where the raw term was strong (BR, TR) the member keeps it — the OPTICS dominate; where it was weak (BL, TL) the residual member angle is ill-defined (e <= 0.06, rotations 1-90 deg) — no drift-coupled rotation toward the x-axis is visible at any corner. The members' worst corners are the RIGHT ones: TR 2.48-3.27 / BR 2.42-3.29 px, night-ordered (aug14 > aug09 > july31-03 ~ aug06 > july31-01). STEP 3, THE CORPUS'S BL: at y-down (700,4200) the corpus reads 3.033/0.832 and at (1300,4900) 2.732/0.830 (800-px, top-30; elongation 12 / 11 deg off local +RA, e 0.18), and NO member holds a full 800-px box at either — the corpus's bottom-left corner is built from members' PARTIAL coverage: UNATTRIBUTABLE by GO #6's rule. SUPPLEMENT (400-px boxes, top-15, outside the pre-registered rule): the members that reach (700,4200) are aug14/set-04 sub_05/sub_06 and july31/set-03 sub_04/sub_05, those reaching (1300,4900) july31/set-01 sub_04/sub_05 — every one contributes from its own TOP-RIGHT corner zone (rho 0.81-0.90, the ENTRY side, 221-307 px from its edge): the corpus's bottom-left corner IS the members' top-right corners (the canvas is rotated ~180 deg relative to the members — the RA flip GO #6 measured, and Dec too). Corpus vs the reaching members at 400 px: (700,4200) 3.065/0.814 vs median 2.750/0.842 (aug14 2.925/2.975 at 0.83-0.85, july31-03 2.555/2.575 at 0.84) — +0.315 px over the median (0.05 past the corrected +0.265 allowance), roundness -0.028 (within 0.03): NEITHER by the letter, the corpus sitting between its aug14 and july31 contributors plus the floor; (1300,4900) 2.660/0.854 vs july31/set-01's 2.430/0.921 and 2.440/0.920 — +0.225 (within 0.265) but roundness -0.067 (past 0.03): NEITHER, and here the corpus's elongation lies 19 deg off +RA while both members' lie 33-38 deg off — at the corpus's very rim, fed by two members of one set from their entry-side corner, the compose adds a roundness loss with the elongation turned toward the drift axis: the one drift-coupled addition this test found, at the thinnest coverage. WHAT THIS PICKS: the corners are the same story as the mid-row — the members' entry-side (right) corners carry a night-ordered optical elongation that is in the raws (radial at the bottom, x-near at the top), stacking rounds the weak (exit-side) corners and keeps the strong ones, and the corpus's worst corner is those right-hand member corners composed at rho 0.8-0.9 — member selection/weighting by measured shape reaches it; the rim-only drift-coupled roundness loss at (1300,4900) is a separate, compose-side term where only two members reach.

top-30 statistics on 16-60 stars per raw corner box (n 13-81) — the top-30 is the whole population at some corners; the 3-raw medians carry the set
